entities.name: UAC-0063
entities.gloss: A cyber espionage threat group active since at least 2021 targeting entities across Eurasia.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A country in Eastern Europe whose government bodies were targeted in the incident.

entities.name: Посольство Таджикистану в Україні
entities.gloss: The diplomatic mission of Tajikistan located in Ukraine whose email was compromised.

entities.name: Таджикистан
entities.gloss: A landlocked country in Central Asia.

entities.name: HATVIBE
entities.gloss: An encoded VBScript downloader malware used to deliver subsequent payloads.

entities.name: LOGPIE
entities.gloss: A Python-based keylogger and clipboard logger malware.

entities.name: CHERRYSPY
entities.gloss: A Python backdoor malware capable of executing code received from a command-and-control server.

entities.name: STILLARCH
entities.gloss: A malware utility also known as DOWNEX used for file discovery and exfiltration.

entities.name: DOWNEX
entities.gloss: An alternate name for the STILLARCH malware family.

entities.name: PyArmor
entities.gloss: A command-line tool used to obfuscate and protect Python scripts.

entities.name: Themida
entities.gloss: A software protection system used to protect applications against reverse engineering.

entities.name: Монголія
entities.gloss: A landlocked country in East Asia identified among the threat group's targets.

entities.name: Казахстан
entities.gloss: A transcontinental country in Central Asia and Eastern Europe targeted by UAC-0063.

entities.name: Киргизстан
entities.gloss: A landlocked country in Central Asia targeted by the threat group.

entities.name: Ізраїль
entities.gloss: A country in the Middle East identified as an interest of UAC-0063.

entities.name: Індія
entities.gloss: A country in South Asia identified as a target of interest for the group.
An IP address used for network communications in the campaign.
An IP address associated with the command and control infrastructure.
An IP address identified as part of the threat actor's infrastructure.

An IP address listed among the network infrastructure indicators.

entities.name: diagnostic-resolver.com
entities.gloss: A malicious domain used for command and control infrastructure.

entities.name: net-certificate.services
entities.gloss: A malicious domain name associated with UAC-0063 infrastructure.

entities.name: ms-webdav-miniredir.com
entities.gloss: A malicious domain name used for network communications and data collection.
